blocks.text: The betrayal deepens as the household is handed onward and the captive line of the family is pushed toward Sirhind, with pressure building around Mata Gujri and the younger children. (17–20)
Courtly advisers such as Sucha Nand are drawn into the matter, while Sher Muhammad and others around the Sirhind administration begin to position themselves around the fate of the captives. (21–25)
This page makes Mata Gujri central to the emotional and political drama: the separation is no longer only a private loss but a case moving toward state violence. (overall)
